ios.desc:
HN Pro shows you Hacker News the way it was meant to be. If you want splashy animations and an unnecessary coat of paint, HN Pro may not be for you.

But, if you've learned to love that classic orange and beige and want everything to just "work" like the web app, you've come to the right place.

Browse your stories, reply to comments, upvote, hide, collapse threads, the list goes on. Do everything that you might want to do using your web browser, right in the palm of your hand. If you login with your account, any threads you collapse or stories you hide carry over to your web browser (and vice versa).

Dark mode? Check.

Comment replies? Check.

Flagging, hiding, upvoting (and "unvoting"?)? Check.

Access to all of the lists? Check (including /news, /show, /shownew, /ask, /best, /active, /newest, /classic, and /noobstories).

Other features I probably forgot about? Check.

Many other improvements are in the pipeline. Have an idea? Shoot me an email at dan@lionheartsw.com.

Coming soon: push notifications for comment replies. Stay tuned.

quotes.text:
I maintain a relatively new one called HN Pro [1]. It was rated 5/5 on the iOS App Store until Friday's HN updates broke parsing, but that bug has since been fixed. I'd love more folks to try it out and provide some feedback.

The app is privacy-first; no tracking or analytics SDKs are installed. You can log in with your username, upvote, downvote, and comment. The idea is to provide as close to the web experience as possible in terms of "feel" and not to add any extra flair.

I'd love to work more on it, so if folks have any ideas with respect to monetization or marketing, I'm all ears! FWIW, I've been recently toying around with the idea of just open-sourcing it and making it donation-only. Haven't really come to any conclusions yet.

Also, I'm aware of some UX/UI issues with the latest update—it had been a while since the previous build and recent UIKit changes have created some wonkiness. :)

[1]: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hn-pro/id1384303792
